verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a state business-filing portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no API at all. The probes only show bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) on www.nvsos.gov and the ORION filing portal, which close the transaction surface to keyless agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
